config.emptyProviders: No custom providers yet; BYOK endpoints are configured in two layers (provider, then model). Add a provider first.
config.setDefaultTooltip: Set as default model (modelProvider + model in settings.json)
config.deleteProviderConfirm: Delete provider {name}? Its API key will also be removed from auth.json
config.modelsEmpty: This provider has no models yet
config.providerIdHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; used as the providers.json key and as the prefix of the default model. Cannot be changed after creation.
config.providerNameHint: Shown only inside this plugin; not written to config files
config.editProviderNameHint: Renaming also updates the default model reference in settings.json
config.modelIdHint: Model identifier sent to the API, e.g. deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash; may contain slashes
config.modelInProvider: Will be written as a model entry under provider {name}
config.modelFollowsProviderApi: Protocol follows the provider ({api}); models do not set it separately
config.baseUrlHint: The CLI appends /chat/completions, /responses or /v1/messages, so usually stop at .../v1
config.contextDefaultHint: Leave empty to use the provider default
config.apiKeySavedPlaceholder: Saved in auth.json; leaving empty keeps it, a new value overwrites
config.apiKeyHint: Written to ~/.commandcode/auth.json (same place /connect uses); providers.json only stores a reference, never plaintext
config.apiKeyClearHint: Use the clear button to remove this provider's key from auth.json
config.apiKeyCleared: Removed this provider's API key from auth.json
config.reasoningEffortsHint: Only tick the levels this model actually supports; unknown values are dropped by the CLI
config.costHint: USD per million tokens; leave empty to skip writing a price
config.optionsHint: Extra fields passed through to the upstream request body
config.namePlaceholder: Name shown in the model picker
config.fetchingModels: Fetching the model list from this provider…
config.editIdSyncHint: The default model follows automatically if it points at this ID
config.modelsDisabledHint: This provider is disabled; its models will not appear in cmd's model picker

provider.idInvalid: Provider ID may only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit
provider.updatedRenamed: Provider renamed to {name}; the default model reference was updated

mcp.tip: User-scope mcpServers in mcp.json; the toggle writes enabled
mcp.enableBeforeTools: Enable this server before inspecting its tools
mcp.transportHint: stdio runs a local subprocess; http connects to a remote URL

skill.tip: User-scope skills in ~/.commandcode/skills; disabling moves them into .disabled/
skill.empty: No skills installed; install one from SkillHub / ModelScope above, or drop it into the directory manually

taste.tip: Taste is Command Code's preference learning package: project scope lives in <project>/.commandcode/taste, global scope in ~/.commandcode/taste
taste.empty: This taste package has no preferences yet
taste.emptyHint: Working normally in Command Code teaches taste as you go; you can also add entries by hand here
taste.categoryNameHint: The name becomes a subdirectory name and cannot contain / or \
taste.deleteCategoryConfirm: Delete category {name} and all of its entries?
taste.categoryInlineTip: Stays in taste.md while it has at most {max} entries
taste.categoryFileTip: Split into {path} once it exceeds {max} entries
taste.categoryOrphanTip: The subdirectory exists but the main file does not reference it; saving adds the reference
taste.entryEmpty: No entries in this category yet
taste.entryTextPlaceholder: e.g. Use const instead of let for non-reassigned variables
taste.entryTextHint: Do not end with a period; one is added on save. Describing what to do is followed more reliably than explaining why.
taste.confidenceHint: Below 0.6 usually means still tentative; above 0.85 means well established
taste.splitNotice: This category has {count} entries, above the {max} limit; saving splits it into a separate file
taste.mergeNotice: This category is back within {max} entries; saving merges it into the main file
taste.summaryDuplicatesEmpty: No preference is repeated across categories or scopes
taste.noProjects: No Command Code projects discovered yet; projects open with cmd appear here automatically, or pick a directory manually

usage.tip: Source: per-turn usage in ~/.commandcode/projects/<project>/<session>.jsonl (same accounting as /usage)
usage.empty: No Command Code usage recorded yet
usage.emptyHint: Running a session with cmd creates {path}; ignore this if you have not installed or used it
usage.modelHint: Split by model from per-turn usage: uncached input + cache read + cache write + output
